lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows and vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid pattern across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice where the blobs are positioned as nodes within a grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-reflecting upper surfaces and shadowed lower surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, dark horizontal linear laceration or scar is present on the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill area towards the tail, indicated by a white graphical arrow.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits features a high-density cluster of smaller, less-defined high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the posterior flank.
